fields.label: floatstone
fields.description: A block of floatstone weighs what a lie weighs. Spun glass whirled into tangles, frozen mid-swirl, strong the way a woven thing is strong -- it will not burn, it barely presses on the hand that carries it, and a wall of it looks like swirled stone spun sugar cut into blocks. The Farmers sell it by the promise instead of the weight. Nobody has ever asked for the weight back. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: fleet flier
fields.description: A small, quick-winged creature that darts into the Forge's vapor columns to graze on fireweed before the heat catches up with it. It never lingers - a fleet flier on the open ground is a fleet flier running out of time. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: dhokkur
fields.description: Half the outcrops on the skirts are stone. The other half are waiting for rain. A dormant dhokkur sits out the still heat as a hill of banked obsidian plates, ash drifted into its seams, and the survey crews learn the difference the day the sky opens: the hill stands up. It walks its own path -- the same path, worn a thousand bursts deep -- drinking the scald straight off its back while everything else on the mountain runs for a roof. It is not angry. It has never needed to be. Its hide turns the boiling rain, and the boiling rain is the worst thing this mountain knows how to say. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: julmox
fields.description: Low and wide as a cooling slab, on feet spread into plates that never sink into hot ash. Between rains the julmox squats sealed, lids down over every seam, a row of dull kettles on the skirts. Then the burst passes, the rock steams, the moss film blooms -- and the herd fans open and goes to work, cropping the two hours the mountain allows. The Farmers keep them for the same reason the mountain does: they are patient, they are sealed against the worst of it, and they turn stone-film into meat. Pasture is wherever it last rained. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: jossur
fields.description: The columns are pasture, and every pasture gets its wolf. The jossur rides the vent updrafts on wings longer than the rest of it put together, hanging in the shimmer where the fleet fliers race and the young fumeriders drift -- and then it stops hanging. Grounded, it is an awkward folded thing, all wing-knuckle and stilt, mantling over its kill in the ash. Airborne, it is the reason the herds keep their young in the middle of the smoke. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: dhuvvox
fields.description: Kick through the ash between rains and you will turn up little glazed nodules, heavy for their size, and think them slag. Then the rain comes down boiling, and the slag hatches. For two hours the skirts run with dhuvvox -- a floor of quick glitter stripping the wet rock of everything the flash woke -- and when the stone dries they seal where they stand and are slag again. The old hands tell time by them. When the dhuvvox run, you reap; when they still, you are already late for shelter. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: fire lavender
fields.description: A lavender that has adapted to survive off the glow of magma, thriving in heat that would kill any ordinary flower. Well loved for its beauty despite — or because of — the furnace it grows in. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: heatsink fungus
fields.description: Using a complex mix of chemical reactions, this fungus draws in heat to fuel its own growth. Settlers build around it, or move it indoors, to take the edge off a scorching room. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: cinder crust
fields.description: A tough, ash-grey crust-fungus that clings to cooling rock at the skirts of the massif, baked hard by radiant heat rather than any light it drinks. Nothing much eats it and nothing much kills it; it is the first thing to grow back after a boiling-rain burst scalds a slope bare. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: floatstone garden
fields.description: When the melt freezes over and the plumes stand tall, the crust blooms. A floatstone garden starts as a knot of glass threads and whirls itself outward into a lace-walled globe, chamber over chamber, light enough that a grown one strains at its own root. Caught ripe, it is the most beautiful quarry on the planet. Left standing, it tears free ahead of the melt and drifts away over the seams -- the one form the lava never gets back. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: floatstone
fields.description: A block of floatstone weighs what a lie weighs. Spun glass whirled into tangles, frozen mid-swirl, strong the way a woven thing is strong -- it will not burn, it barely presses on the hand that carries it, and a wall of it looks like swirled stone spun sugar cut into blocks. The Farmers sell it by the promise instead of the weight. Nobody has ever asked for the weight back. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: dhokkur hide
fields.description: Plated hide from a dhokkur, glassy black and heavier than it looks. The boiling rain runs off it without leaving a mark; forge-hands prize it for anything that has to stand between a body and the heat. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: floatstone keel brace
fields.description: A pearl-white brace of spun floatstone, threaded through a gravship's frame along the lines its strain runs. It weighs almost nothing and gives almost nothing, so the grav engine lifts the ship with less help from its thrusters: every linked brace cuts the fuel a flight burns. A gravship can carry up to four keel braces. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: basalt shingle
fields.description: A fresh skin of black basalt plates over lava the boiling rain has quenched. Walkable, still warm, and temporary: the fire underneath has not gone anywhere. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: pumice rubble
fields.description: Frothed, glassy pumice chunks where the quenched melt boiled as it set. Light, sharp-edged, crunching underfoot, and gone again at the next melt. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: glowing cracks
fields.description: The crust is splitting from below, red light showing in every seam. It will melt back into open lava soon. Do not stand here. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: boiling rain
fields.description: A sudden, violent downpour of scalding rain, flashing back to steam off the hot rock within seconds of falling. Scalds anyone caught in the open. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: forge still
fields.description: Long, still, baking heat under a haze of vent-steam. The mountain is between rains. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: red fog
fields.description: A thick red haze off the hot rock that reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: the mountain's breath
fields.description: The Forge rains on itself: long still heat, broken by sudden violent bursts of scalding rain that flash back to steam off the hot rock within seconds. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: run ending
fields.description: The wet rock is drying and the run is nearly over. It is slowing, about to curl back into its nodule. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: spunstone bonding
fields.description: Floatstone is strong the way a woven thing is strong: its glass threads hand strain to one another. Learn to lay it in the grain and it can brace a gravship's frame for almost no weight. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: the Forge
fields.description: One mountain, three zones, and the only vertical skyline for a hundred kilometres: tall, dark foundry towers rising defiantly against the sun, streaming vent-steam like banners. Below them the red seams and the flows; around them the ash skirts; above them, improbably, herds -- vast placid gas-grazers drifting in the vapor columns. The mountain rains on itself in scalding bursts, and mosses drink in the seconds between fall and flash. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: scald
fields.description: A wound from scalding steam and boiling water - a wet burn. Ordinary heat- or flame-rated armor gives no protection against it; only apparel built specifically for it does. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes
